text.formatted:
You gain the following Cunning Strike option.

_**Stealth Attack (Cost: 1d6).**_ If you have the Hide action's Invisible condition, this attack doesn't end that condition on you if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover.
text.plain:
You gain the following Cunning Strike option.

Stealth Attack (Cost: 1d6). If you have the Hide action's Invisible condition, this attack doesn't end that condition on you if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover.

gaps.name: Stealth Attack must preserve Hide through this attack, selected when Sneak Attack damage is dealt, and end that preserved condition at turn end unless behind Three-Quarters or Total Cover.
